hooks.name: Format check + file length on save
hooks.description: After a Python file is saved: ruff format check and the 200-line file limit. Lint runs in run-tests-on-save.

action.command: uv run ruff format --check . && uv run python scripts/check_file_length.py

hooks.name: No nested loops on save
hooks.description: After a Python file is saved: rejects for-in-for, while-in-for and multi-for comprehensions.

action.command: uv run python scripts/check_nested_loops.py src scripts
